high_level_description: This image captures a serene scene at sunset over a railway track. The sky is painted with hues of orange, pink, and purple, indicating the time is either early morning or late evening. The sun is partially visible on the horizon, casting a warm glow across the landscape. In the foreground, there are multiple railway tracks running parallel to each other. The tracks are surrounded by gravel and some greenery, including small bushes and trees. To the left side of the image, there is a concrete bridge with an arched design, supported by several pillars.
